How do I use it properly the very first time?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question! Here's your simple step-by-step guide for your first tasting:
What you'll need:
Your three Compass Box whiskies
A glass (any glass works, but smaller is better)
Water (spring water or soft tap water)
Plain crackers or bread (optional, to cleanse your palate between samples)
How to taste like a pro:
1. Pour a small amount — just three-quarters of an ounce into your glass. You don't need much!
2. Smell first — Gently bring the glass to your nose. Don't rush! Take your nose away after each sniff and trust the first thing you smell. Repeat to discover other layers. Give your nose a break between whiskies with fresh air and water.
3. Taste — Take a small sip and roll the whisky over your tongue and around your mouth. Savor the flavors. Is it woody? Fruity? Spicy? Notice the texture and intensity too.
4. Add a little water — After your first taste, add a few drops of water. This opens up the spirit and helps you detect finer notes by taking the edge off the alcohol.
5. Cleanse between samples — Alternate sips of water between whiskies to clear your palate. Munch on plain crackers if you have them.
Pro tip: Start with The Story of the Spaniard (smoothest), then The Spice Tree (medium), and finish with The Peat Monster (boldest). This builds up gradually!
